title: HLA review header
description: The fenced yaml block at the top of hla.md. Uses only the JSON Schema subset validate_doc.py implements: type, required, properties, items, enum, pattern, minItems, and if/then on a const.

architecture_owner.description: The person accountable for the design and for answering review questions.

document_version.description: Quoted, so 1.0 stays a string. Raise the minor number on each review round.

status.description: draft while written, in-review once handed to reviewers; only a person sets accepted, changes-requested or declined.

reviewers.description: Names given by the owner. Never invented.

signed_off_by.description: Filled by the person who records the review decision.

signed_off_on.description: Date the review decision was recorded.

review_conditions.description: Conditions the reviewers attached to their decision, written by them; a TDD request goes here.

system.description: The product or system this design concerns.

domains.description: Business domains touched, in the organisation's own terms.

target_production_date.description: Planned first production release, when known.

review_level.description: full: reviewers decide on the design. pattern-check: reviewers only confirm it follows a known pattern and accepted ADRs.

impact_flags.description: What makes this design worth reviewing. 'none' stands alone.

data_classification.description: The highest classification of data the design stores or moves.

security_consultation_required.description: No default. True whenever the design touches authentication, authorization, roles, groups or machine-to-machine access, even when an ADR is followed.

solution_type.description: greenfield: nothing replaced. brownfield: existing systems extended. modernization: existing systems replaced or moved.

decision_needed.description: Questions the reviewers must answer, each answerable with a choice. Write 'none' for a pattern check with nothing to decide.

decision_deadline.description: Date by which the reviewers' decision is needed.

reference_pattern.description: The approved pattern or reference design followed, if any.

exceptions.description: Departures from accepted ADRs or standards.

repositories.description: Repositories the design changes or adds.

adr_registry_commit.description: Commit of the ADR registry the citations were checked against, or 'none' when no registry applies.
